bug_description.original:
Detailed Report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5032227192307712

Project: lz4
Fuzzing Engine: libFuzzer
Fuzz Target: round_trip_fuzzer
Job Type: libfuzzer_asan_lz4
Platform Id: linux

Crash Type: Invalid-free
Crash Address: 0x6310000107ff
Crash State:
  round_trip_fuzzer.c
  
Sanitizer: address (ASAN)
bug_description.normalized: OSS-Fuzz issue 48884: In the lz4 round_trip_fuzzer, the cleanup code calls free(dst) where dst is an interior pointer derived as dstPlusLargePrefix + largeSize and was never itself returned by malloc. The correct pointer to free is the base allocation dstPlusLargePrefix. ASan detects this as an invalid-free (bad-free) at round_trip_fuzzer.c:111.

source.description: Returns the remaining input buffer size from the producer, which the harness assigns to size and uses to compute dstCapacity = LZ4_compressBound(size) and allocate the buffer dstPlusLargePrefix = malloc(dstCapacity + largeSize). This is the first project-code function that materializes the fuzzer input into a value on the vulnerable allocation path.
source.value_from: The fuzzer input bytes determine producer->size via FUZZ_dataProducer_create/retrieve32; this function returns that remaining size, feeding dstCapacity and the allocation.; value `producer->size`; from `return producer->size;`

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.description: free(dst) is called with an interior pointer (dstPlusLargePrefix + largeSize) that was never returned by malloc. ASan detects this as attempting free on address which was not malloc()-ed.

root_cause.description: The cleanup code frees dst instead of dstPlusLargePrefix. Since dst = dstPlusLargePrefix + largeSize, dst is an interior pointer into the dstPlusLargePrefix allocation and is not a valid argument for free. The fix replaces free(dst) with free(dstPlusLargePrefix).

tainted_value_origin.description: The remaining input size is returned to the harness, where it feeds LZ4_compressBound(size) → dstCapacity → malloc(dstCapacity + largeSize) → dstPlusLargePrefix.

fine_trace.note: Returns the remaining input buffer size after seed extraction. The caller assigns this to size (line 19), which feeds LZ4_compressBound(size) → dstCapacity, determining the allocation that will be incorrectly freed.

Allocates a heap buffer of dstCapacity + largeSize bytes. dstPlusLargePrefix is the malloc-returned base pointer and the sole valid argument for free. ASan confirms the allocation: 0x631000000800 with region size 65551 (= LZ4_compressBound(size) + 65535).

Derives an interior pointer dst at offset largeSize (65535) into the dstPlusLargePrefix allocation. dst is used as the compression/decompression target buffer but is not a malloc-returned pointer. ASan confirms: the freed address 0x6310000107ff is exactly 65535 bytes inside the allocated region.

fine_trace.code: int const dstSize = LZ4_compress_default((const char*)data, dst, size, dstCapacity);
fine_trace.note: Compression writes into the interior pointer dst. All FUZZ_ASSERT checks between this point and line 111 pass for the witnessed PoC, so execution reaches the cleanup block unconditionally.

Calls free on the interior pointer dst (= dstPlusLargePrefix + 0xFFFF). This address is 65535 bytes inside the dstPlusLargePrefix allocation and was never returned by malloc. ASan reports: attempting free on address which was not malloc()-ed at 0x6310000107ff. The fix replaces free(dst) with free(dstPlusLargePrefix).

format.name: libFuzzer binary blob for round_trip_fuzzer
format.contract: Any input that passes FUZZ_dataProducer_create and the subsequent LZ4 compress/decompress assertions (all code paths between lines 17-108 succeed) reaches the free(dst) invalid-free at line 111. The bug is unconditional: every parser-admissible input reaches the sink because the invalid free is on the normal cleanup path.

parser_admitted.description: The PoC input passes LZ4_compress_default and the FUZZ_ASSERT(dstSize > 0) check, proving the input is compressible and the path toward cleanup (and the invalid free at line 111) is reachable.
